summary: You carry a quiet power people sense before you speak. Who you are and deep force flow together, giving you the ability to reinvent yourself and a presence that doesn't need to push. You survive things.
body: You carry a quiet power people sense before you speak. Who you are and deep force flow together, giving you the ability to reinvent yourself and a presence that doesn't need to push. You survive things. You can rebuild your whole life when you need to, and your influence tends to grow without you forcing it. Because the power is natural, the risk is coasting on it, or using it to control quietly rather than transform. Turn it on yourself and you become someone who keeps getting realer.
gift: At your best: magnetic, regenerative, powerful without forcing it.
shadow: The trap: coasting on natural power, or using it to control instead of transform.
integration: Let identity and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Real influence; the intensity tends to polarize people.
do: Aim the power at your own reinvention
Use presence to transform, not control
